fieldValues.title: B3. Rule
fieldValues.thinking_reached:
Aim: settle a standing choice once, so later work can cite it.

Tried: the srs /rfc pipeline with Charter Check, doors and modes; the programme decision log, four tests and seven kinds; /session; parked decisions (684f84ab); cite, never re-ask (4445b9cf).
fieldValues.tensions:
- Trade-offs: spec-led ↔ implementation-led, and convention ↔ enforcement. The rule says spec first (e337703b); in practice implementation ran ahead (RFC-003 export, MCP tools without an RFC). Programme rulings come fast: 98 decision records in about 16 days.
- Gone wrong: rulings made but not executed (SP-02; relation rules R1 to R11 unenforced for 12 weeks); decision quality weak (policy a catch-all, 24 of 47; none scoped to a domain; 22 with no alternatives); rulings live outside records, so 25 parked issues could only become exercises (finding d072ce9b). Deciding is not the bottleneck: 83 ratified, 5 proposed.
